title: Don Alexis unto the Reader
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secrets of the Reuerend Maister Alexis of Piemont
summary: In the preface to his book of secrets, the aged Alexis explains why he is publishing remedies he once guarded jealously: a poor artisan died of the stone in Milan after Alexis refused to share his cure with the surgeon, and in remorse he now resolves to give all his tested secrets to the world.
